subject: Post-call: performance gating & geo routing plan for FinSight pilot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jake Myers <jake@finsight.ai>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@finsight.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 20:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: performance gating & geo routing plan for FinSight pilot

Hi Jake / Asha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the pilot scope: 

What we heard from your side:
- Primary use case: low-latency live insights in the FinSight UI (tokenized streaming responses for analyst queries).
- Target customers in pilot: NA + EU regional accounts, APAC later.
- Compliance constraint: EU-subset of requests & dataset must remain in EU region.

Immediate asks from FinSight for qualification:
1) Latency SLOs (p50/p95) for single-turn generation and streaming token latency.
2) Throughput: steady RPS and expected concurrency (steady vs peak).
3) Expected request size distribution (avg tokens per request, tail).
4) Any pre-warm/pinned model need for canary.

Our proposed next steps:
- You: confirm the numbers above and attach example request payloads (or sample logs).
- Us: produce a pilot performance plan (region mapping, routing policy, SLO gating, caching/batching config) and an optional dedicated reserved pool quote.
- Schedule a 60-minute tech deep-dive next week to validate token-level latency and streaming handshake.

Attachments: FinSight_SLO_template.xlsx (SLO fields + example payload), pilot-scope-one-pager.pdf

Proposed time for tech call: Wed 2027-05-12 or Thu 2027-05-13 (I put availability in the Calendly link below).

Thanks — will put Monica on the thread to map the performance plan and Marissa for commercial constraints.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
https://calendly.com/sean-gallagher/redwood-tech-call-60
From: Jake Myers <jake@finsight.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@finsight.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: performance gating & geo routing plan for FinSight pilot

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. Below are the numbers we can commit for the pilot and a couple clarifications: 

Pilot scope data (rough):
- Steady concurrency: 30 concurrent sessions across our UI (each session produces streaming tokens at low rate).
- Peak concurrency: 180 concurrent sessions (burst events during market open).
- Avg request size: ~180 tokens / request, 95th pctile request size ~600 tokens.
- Expected qps: steady ~22 RPS; peak burst up to ~120 RPS for short windows.
- Token volume: ~900k tokens/day across pilot accounts.

Latency targets:
- Non-streaming (round-trip generation) target: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 380ms (for 180-token requests).
- Streaming/token latency target: p50 <= 45ms per token, p95 <= 150ms per token.
- For EU customers, we require data and inference to remain in EU region for requests originating from our EU tenants (no cross-border routing of payloads).

Other constraints:
- We will supply sample payloads (sanitized) and representative production traces.
- For the commercial pilot, we prefer Redwood to propose a reserved pool for EU traffic if that simplifies residency and latency reliability.

Happy to hop on a tech call Wed 05/12 at 10:00am PDT if that works for your team.

Best,
Jake Myers
Head of Product Engineering | FinSight Analytics
jake@finsight.ai | +1 212-555-0199
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: performance gating & geo routing plan for FinSight pilot

Sean — copied you on the initial internal plan. Key points I want captured before the tech call with FinSight: 

Proposed Redwood pilot config (draft):
- Regions: eu-west1 for EU tenants (data residency + inference), us-west1 for NA, ap-southeast1 as optional for APAC later.
- Routing policy: source-IP region mapping + explicit tenant header we can use to pin requests to region; fallback to US only if explicitly permitted.
- Dedicated reservation: offer a small dedicated pool in eu-west1 (8 vGPU equivalent) to guarantee p95 under burst.
- Batching/caching: we will enable prefix KV caching for repeated analyst queries and a short continuous batching window (10–25ms) to improve throughput without sacrificing streaming handshake.
- Streaming: use Redwood streaming protocol with token-level ACK; we should validate handshake cost during tech call.

SLO gating proposal to present (we should get buy-in on these thresholds):
- p50 generation <= 100ms, p95 generation <= 350ms (for up to 200 tokens).
- token streaming latency p95 <= 160ms.
- throughput: sustain 100 RPS with spikes to 150 RPS per region for the pilot (we can increase with reserved capacity).

Questions for FinSight to confirm pre-call:
1) Can you provide a short sample set of requests with percentiles (we asked for that in the SLO template)?
2) Do you need EU-only telemetry/audit logs stored in EU KMS?
3) Any strict TLS/mTLS or SIEM integrations we should provision ahead of pilot?

I will prepare the draft SLO table and a region mapping diagram before the tech call. Marissa — can you confirm if offering a 90-day reserved discount is on the table for this pilot?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jake Myers <jake@finsight.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: performance gating & geo routing plan for FinSight pilot

Jake / Asha — thanks for the data. Quick reply with concrete next steps and a proposed pilot timeline.

Confirmed pilot ask from Redwood side:
- Tech deep-dive Wed 2027-05-12 at 10:00am PDT (we completed the session and captured logs).
- Action: FinSight to upload sample payloads + traces into the SLO template (we received these in Dropbox link). We will run a short synthetic and then a small production-mirrored run.
- Redwood deliverable (by Tue 2027-05-18): Pilot Performance Plan including region mapping, SLO table (p50/p95), dedicated pool sizing, and a runbook for failover and data residency enforcement.
- Commercial: Marissa will produce a pilot quote with reserved capacity option for eu-west1; Marissa — can you send by 2027-05-17?

Requested confirmations from FinSight:
- Agree to the p95 streaming cap of 160ms for pilot acceptance testing? (We proposed p95 <=160ms; you listed p95 <=150ms — we can aim for 150ms in a best-effort but want 160ms as acceptance).
- Confirm EU-residency requirement: all EU-tenant inference and logs will be confined to eu-west1 with EU KMS binding.

Links & artifacts:
- Pilot SLO template: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/sales/SLO-template
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FS-2027-042
- DocuSign for pilot MSA: https://docusign.com/FS-042-pilot-msa (placeholder)

If these items look good I will mark the deal as pilot-engaged and Monica will coordinate the test window. Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running.
